purpose: Explain a gradual setup for coding agents

required_facts.fact: Choose an assistant before advanced configuration.
A small end-to-end real task tests fit.
Allow-lists and skip-permissions have different risks.
APIs and CLI tools enable automation.
Claude and Codex skills require conventional folders.
Subagents protect the main context from large inputs.
CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md provide project context.

author_attribution: Explain Alexey's recommended sequence without turning it into an unsupported universal rule.
